english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a line placed under text for emphasis, italics, or a hyperlink.

examples.english: Adding an underline to this text makes it easier to see that it is a key point.
examples.traditional: 呢段字加條底線，就容易睇到係重點。
examples.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 zi6 gaa1 tiu4 dai2 sin3 zau6 jung4 ji6 tai2 dou2 hai6 zung6 dim2

english.note: Use this for the lowest acceptable boundary, especially a personal, practical, or negotiable limit.

examples.traditional: 呢個價錢係我嘅底線喇。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 gaa3 cin2 hai6 ngo5 ge3 dai2 sin3 laa3
